scope: Raw imported module theorem records in the final local closure; includes private/generated names and possible duplicate names from different module records.
comparison: Lean Std.HashMap Expr equality; candidate grouping only; no definitional equality search.
limitations: A wrapper and its original proof may have identical types but cannot replace each other without checking the import graph.
Repeated fully qualified names in raw module records are not independent replacement targets.
Generated proof auxiliaries are not independently editable source declarations.
Each selected rewrite still requires compiler checking, raw retained-interface comparisons, and downstream validation.
